why: The permission default of a tracked Claude settings file. The fail side sets the mode that stops asking before any tool runs: current clients ignore it from a project file and older ones honored it, and removing it costs nothing, so it fails. The pass side sets the planning mode, which asks more, not less. Every content is base64, so no tracked file of this repository holds a live settings key. Whoever drops the mode check turns the fail side green; whoever fails on any mode value turns the pass side red.
